account.description: This cube represents customer accounts from the pu_account table in the CIS system.

account.customerClass.description: Whether the account is residential, commercial or industrial.
account.customerClass.note: Not in the Cube YAML. Added for the commercial-accounts follow-up; the CIS column name (cust_class) is an assumption to confirm.
account.customerClass.title: Customer Class

account.debtorNumber.description: Reference number linking to debtor information and billing details.
account.debtorNumber.title: Debtor Number

account.id.description: Unique identifier combining account number and occupant code (account_no-occupant_code).
account.id.title: Account ID

account.name.description: The name associated with the account.
account.name.title: Account Name

account.occupantCode.description: Code identifying the specific occupant linked to the account.
account.occupantCode.title: Occupant Code

account.serviceAddress.description: Complete service address combining street number, modifier, and street name.
account.serviceAddress.title: Service Address

account.serviceCity.description: The city where the service is located.
account.serviceCity.title: City

account.serviceProvince.description: The province or state where the service is located.
account.serviceProvince.title: Province

account.serviceZipAndPostalCode.description: The postal or zip code for the service location.
account.serviceZipAndPostalCode.sql: CASE WHEN serv_postal_zip = '00000     ' THEN '' ELSE serv_postal_zip END
account.serviceZipAndPostalCode.title: Postal Code

account.title: Account

accountBalance.description: This cube summarizes customer account balances from the pu_account_pay table, filtered to include only active records

accountBalance.accountNumber.description: The primary account number for the customer (part of composite primary key).
accountBalance.accountNumber.title: Account Number

accountBalance.avgBalance.description: Average of the total balance across all records in the filtered dataset.
accountBalance.avgBalance.title: Average Balance

accountBalance.currentBalance.description: The current outstanding balance that is not yet overdue.
accountBalance.currentBalance.title: Current Balance

accountBalance.dueDate.description: The date when payment for this balance is due.
accountBalance.dueDate.title: Payment Due Date

accountBalance.dueDateMonth.description: The month of the payment due date.
accountBalance.dueDateMonth.title: Due Date Month

accountBalance.dueDateYear.description: The year of the payment due date.
accountBalance.dueDateYear.title: Due Date Year

accountBalance.endDate.description: The end date of the billing period for this balance record.
accountBalance.endDate.title: Billing Period End Date

accountBalance.endDateMonth.description: The month of the billing period end date.
accountBalance.endDateMonth.title: Billing End Month

accountBalance.endDateYear.description: The year of the billing period end date.
accountBalance.endDateYear.title: Billing End Year

accountBalance.interestBalance.description: Interest charges applied to outstanding balances.
accountBalance.interestBalance.title: Interest Balance

accountBalance.lastBillAmount.description: Total amount billed in the last billing cycle for this account and utility type.
accountBalance.lastBillAmount.title: Last Bill Amount

accountBalance.lateChargeBalance.description: Total late fees and penalties applied to overdue amounts.
accountBalance.lateChargeBalance.title: Late Charge Balance

accountBalance.occupantCode.description: Code identifying the specific occupant linked to the account (part of composite primary key).
accountBalance.occupantCode.title: Occupant Code

accountBalance.overdueBalance.description: The amount that is past due and requires immediate attention.
accountBalance.overdueBalance.title: Overdue Balance

accountBalance.startDate.description: The start date of the billing period for this balance record.
accountBalance.startDate.title: Billing Period Start Date

accountBalance.startDateMonth.description: The month of the billing period start date.
accountBalance.startDateMonth.title: Billing Start Month

accountBalance.startDateYear.description: The year of the billing period start date.
accountBalance.startDateYear.title: Billing Start Year

accountBalance.totalBalance.description: Combined total of all balance components (current + overdue + late charges + interest).
accountBalance.totalBalance.title: Total Balance

accountBalance.utilityType.description: Type of utility service (e.g., water, electricity, gas) for this balance record (part of composite primary key).
accountBalance.utilityType.title: Utility Type

accountBalance.source_sql: SELECT * FROM pu_account_pay WHERE end_date IS NULL
accountBalance.title: Account Balance

callTypeAnalysis.description: Helps you understand what types of customer service calls are coming in and how many are being logged over time over a specific CSR Agent. Useful for tracking trends, identifying frequent call topics, and improving customer support.

callTypeAnalysis.accountName.description: Name of the customer account associated with the call.
callTypeAnalysis.accountName.issue: references another cube (account.name); cross-cube members are not supported
callTypeAnalysis.accountName.title: Account Name

callTypeAnalysis.callNumber.description: Unique identifier for the call record.
callTypeAnalysis.callNumber.title: Call Number

callTypeAnalysis.callStatus.description: Status of the call (e.g., Scheduled, Completed).
callTypeAnalysis.callStatus.title: Call Status

callTypeAnalysis.callStatusDescription.description: Short description of the call status.
callTypeAnalysis.callStatusDescription.title: Call Status Description

callTypeAnalysis.callType.description: Type of customer service call (e.g., MOVEIN, RECON, AUTO).
callTypeAnalysis.callType.title: Call Type

callTypeAnalysis.callTypeDescription.description: Short description of the call type.
callTypeAnalysis.callTypeDescription.title: Call Type Description

callTypeAnalysis.completedOn.description: Timestamp of when the call was completed.
callTypeAnalysis.completedOn.title: Completed On

callTypeAnalysis.createdBy.description: The CSR who created the call.
callTypeAnalysis.createdBy.title: CSR Agent

callTypeAnalysis.createdOn.description: Timestamp of when the call record was created in the system.
callTypeAnalysis.createdOn.title: Call Created Date

callTypeAnalysis.currentStatus.description: The current status of the call (alias for callStatusDescription).
callTypeAnalysis.currentStatus.title: Current Status of the Call

callTypeAnalysis.description.description: Human-readable description of the call type from the reference table.
callTypeAnalysis.description.title: Call Type Description

callTypeAnalysis.isServiceOrder.description: Indicates whether the CSR call is a service order.
callTypeAnalysis.isServiceOrder.sql: CASE WHEN (ordercode) IS NULL THEN 'FALSE' ELSE 'TRUE' END
callTypeAnalysis.isServiceOrder.title: Is Service Order

callTypeAnalysis.month.description: Abbreviated name of the month extracted from the call creation date.
callTypeAnalysis.month.sql: CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM createdon) WHEN 1 THEN 'JAN' WHEN 2 THEN 'FEB' WHEN 3 THEN 'MAR' WHEN 4 THEN 'APR' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAY' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUN' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUL' WHEN 8 THEN 'AUG' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEP' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV' WHEN 12 THEN 'DEC' END
callTypeAnalysis.month.title: Call Month Name

callTypeAnalysis.orderNo.description: Order number associated with the call (legacy ASP queries 1-2).
callTypeAnalysis.orderNo.title: Order Number

callTypeAnalysis.scheduledOn.description: Timestamp of when the call is scheduled.
callTypeAnalysis.scheduledOn.title: Scheduled On

callTypeAnalysis.summaryDescription.description: Short summary of the call type (alias for callTypeDescription).
callTypeAnalysis.summaryDescription.title: Call Summary Description

callTypeAnalysis.totalCalls.description: Total number of call records logged in the system.
callTypeAnalysis.totalCalls.title: Total Calls

callTypeAnalysis.source_sql: SELECT calld.call_number AS call_number, calld.createdon AS createdon, calld.calltype AS calltype, calld.callcode AS callcode, calld.order_no AS order_no, calld.ordercode AS ordercode, calltype.description AS description, calld.createdby AS createdby, calld.account_no AS account_no, calld.occupant_code AS occupant_code, calld.scheduledon AS scheduledon, calld.completedon AS completedon, calld.callstatus AS callstatus, calltype.shortdesc AS calldesc, callstatus.shortdesc AS statdesc FROM csrcalld calld LEFT JOIN csrctypr calltype ON calld.calltype = calltype.calltype AND calld.callcode = calltype.callcode LEFT JOIN csrstatc callstatus ON calld.callstatus = callstatus.callstatus
callTypeAnalysis.title: Call Type Analysis

cashBatchData.description: Tracks batches of cash transactions submitted by users. Useful for understanding when and by whom cash entries were submitted. Ideal for reconciling daily or periodic cash activity.

cashBatchData.batchId.description: Identifier for the batch in which the transaction is grouped.
cashBatchData.batchId.title: Batch ID

cashBatchData.batchName.description: This represents the name of the batch.
cashBatchData.batchName.title: Batch Name

cashBatchData.cashierUsername.description: The identifier for the cashier who performed the transaction.
cashBatchData.cashierUsername.title: Cashier Username

cashBatchData.entryNumber.description: The unique entry number for each transaction record.
cashBatchData.entryNumber.title: Entry Number

cashBatchData.tenderedAmount.description: Sum of tendered amounts across transactions.
cashBatchData.tenderedAmount.title: Amount Tendered

cashBatchData.transactionDate.description: The exact date and time when the transaction occurred.
cashBatchData.transactionDate.title: Transaction Date

cashBatchData.transactionMonth.description: The month of the transaction date, used for monthly aggregation.
cashBatchData.transactionMonth.title: Transaction Month

cashBatchData.transactionYear.description: The year of the transaction date, used for yearly aggregation.
cashBatchData.transactionYear.title: Transaction Year

cashBatchData.source_sql: select batchid, userid, trans_date, tendered_amt, entry_no, icpcashm.login AS login FROM icpcashm JOIN icphdrh ON icphdrh.login = icpcashm.login
cashBatchData.title: Cash Batch Data

cashDetail.description: Provides a detailed list of individual cash transactions. Best used when exporting data to Excel/CSV or reviewing all transactions for a specific day (Run Date). Great for audits or detailed reporting.

cashDetail.accountNumber.description: Internal account number associated with the cash balance entry.
cashDetail.accountNumber.title: Account Number

cashDetail.arDescription.description: Description of the accounts receivable transaction.
cashDetail.arDescription.title: AR Description

cashDetail.journalNumber.description: Journal entry number from the general ledger.
cashDetail.journalNumber.title: Journal Number

cashDetail.occupantCode.description: Identifier for the occupant tied to the account; used in filtering and joins.
cashDetail.occupantCode.title: Occupant Code

cashDetail.runDate.description: Date when the cash balance snapshot was generated for reporting.
cashDetail.runDate.title: Run Date

cashDetail.sequenceId.description: Unique sequence number for the transaction record from balance history.
cashDetail.sequenceId.title: Sequence ID

cashDetail.transactionAmount.description: Total amount of the cash balance transaction; summed across records.
cashDetail.transactionAmount.title: Transaction Amount

cashDetail.transactionDate.description: Date when the transaction actually occurred.
cashDetail.transactionDate.title: Transaction Date

cashDetail.transactionMonth.description: First day of the month for the transaction date, used for monthly rollups.
cashDetail.transactionMonth.title: Transaction Month

cashDetail.transactionYear.description: First day of the year for the transaction date, used for yearly rollups.
cashDetail.transactionYear.title: Transaction Year

cashDetail.source_sql: SELECT pu_balance_hist.account_no as account_no, pu_balance_hist.occupant_code as occupant_code, run_date, trans_date, jour_code, jour_no, trans_amt, ar_descript, pu_balance_hist.sequence_ FROM pu_balance_hist JOIN pu_ar_descript ON pu_balance_hist.desc_code = pu_ar_descript.ar_code JOIN glsvdata ON pu_balance_hist.jour_no = glsvdata.jrnl_no WHERE pu_balance_hist.jour_code = 'CR' AND glsvdata.applcode = 'PB' AND glsvdata.journalcode = 'CR'
cashDetail.title: Cash Detail
